Before buying a second-hand watch, ensure your watch's reference number matches with your watch, and secondly ensure your movement has been used by the manufacturer for your reference number. These two checks are not enough but are the main points of a verification..

At Mainspring, we make all the required and detailed inspections before we buy a watch to display in our store and present to our customers. 
We issue a store authenticity liability certificate with each watch we sell and also provide 3 months warranty.

FRANCK MULLER — MASTER OF COMPLICATIONS 🔴⚫️

A seriously bold Franck Muller from the Conquistador Grand Prix collection.

The unmistakable oversized tonneau case combines Red Ergal with black PVD-coated titanium, paired with a black Flammé dial and oversized red Arabic numerals. This exact reference is a discontinued configuration. 

⌚ Franck Muller Conquistador Grand Prix
Master of Complications
Ref. 9900 SC DT GPG TT NR ERG

🔴 Red Ergal case
⚫ PVD-coated titanium bezel & details
🖤 Black Flammé dial
💎 Curved sapphire crystal
📄 With Franck Muller certificate

One icon. Countless personalities. ⌚✨

The Cartier Tank Must has appeared in an incredible variety of dial designs over the years — from timeless Roman numerals and signature railway tracks to bold lacquer colours, Art Deco patterns and more unusual artistic executions.

This guide explores some of the fascinating dial variations that have made the Tank Must such a collectible part of Cartier’s history.
